Overview

Osasco is a city in SP with a population of 701,428. A major commercial and financial center in Greater São Paulo, home to numerous corporate headquarters and shopping centers. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
